name: veydr
description: Local-first desktop supervisor for development commands
author: alexnakagama

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.shared.json && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && npm run build && vitest run --project integration --passWithNoTests
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && npm run build && npm run build:probe && playwright test -c playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:perf: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.perf.config.ts --pass-with-no-tests
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/ensure-electron.cjs && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.test:packaging: npm run dist:linux && vitest run --project packaging
